_doc: BACK TO THE FUTURE PART II — overwrite + true branch. The main 1985A line is ONE lane overwritten in place (each revision an arc on the same lane); alt-1985 is the only genuinely new world (a separate lane). Old Biff's trip is drawn in his own colour and does NOT carry Marty's thread.

meta.title: Back to the Future Part II — The Overwritten Line
meta.subtitle: One history, revised in place · alt-1985 is the branch that really exists · grey = other travellers
meta.footer: Test film 2 of 4 — overwrite grammar. Cites = film beats.

nodes.title: 1985 — The Ordinary Line
nodes.body: Marty, Doc, Jennifer, and the DeLorean — the morning after the first film.

M1985.beat: Doc returns from the future — 'something has got to be done about your kids'
Old Biff steals the DeLorean in 2015 — his grey arc fires the overwrite from 1955
George shot in 1975 · Biff owns the town · Lorraine his wife · Marty's life unmade
Doc deciphers it: the Sports Almanac — the overwrite's root is 1955

laneborn.note: the second visit happens inside the FIRST film's 1955 — overlapping, not branching

L1955B.beat: 1955, two teams: young Biff takes the Almanac · Marty & Doc intercept and burn it — the line heals as they watch
The DeLorean struck by lightning — Doc thrown to 1885; the Western Union letter

ending.title: Part II Ends in 1955
ending.body: Marty stranded: Doc in 1885, the DeLorean gone. The restored 1985 return is Part III's business.

m1.label: to 2015 and back — the kids fixed

ob.label: old Biff gives young Biff the Almanac (1955) — returns to 2015, fades

m3.label: Marty & Doc to 1955 — intercept the Almanac

legend: Green arcs on the main line = Marty & Doc revising ONE history in place (2015, 1985A, 1955).
Grey arc = old Biff, a different traveller — his act rewrites the line but is not the film's path.
1955 appears once as its own lane: the two visits overlap inside the same year. Part II ends stranded in 1955.
